name: IndicGenBench
intro: IndicGenBench 是 ACL 2024 发布的印度语言生成评测集，在 29 种语言、13 种文字和 4 个语系上评估跨语言摘要、双向翻译和三条跨语言问答轨道。
build_method: 复用四个公开数据源，筛选英文样本与现有印度语言译文，并由专业译者补齐任务字段和低资源语言
task_type: 跨语言摘要, 双向机器翻译, 跨语言问答
eval_feature: 29种语言, 13种文字, 4个语系, 高/中/低资源分组
task_type_en: Cross-lingual summarization, bidirectional machine translation, cross-lingual QA
build_method_en: Reuse four public source datasets, select English samples and existing Indic translations, and commission professional translators for missing task fields and lower-resource languages
eval_feature_en: 29 languages, 13 scripts, 4 language families, high/medium/low-resource groups
intro_en: IndicGenBench is the ACL 2024 benchmark for generation in 29 Indic languages across 13 scripts and four language families. It evaluates cross-lingual summarization, translation in both directions, and three cross-lingual QA tracks.
scale_en: 5 evaluation tracks; CrossSum-IN 20.3k, FLORES-IN 58.2k, XQuAD-IN 16.6k, XorQA-IN 32k
metric_en: ChrF for summarization and translation; SQuAD Token-F1 for QA
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2404.16816, the ACL 2024 paper, and the official google-research-datasets/indic-gen-bench repository. The benchmark defines five paper tasks across 29 Indic languages, 13 scripts, and four language families: CrossSum-IN cross-lingual summarization, FLORES-IN machine translation with English-to-Indic and Indic-to-English directions, XQuAD-IN multilingual extractive QA, XorQA-IN-XX with an Indic-language answer, and XorQA-IN-EN with an English answer. The two XorQA answer views share the same 32k source component. Construction starts from CrossSum, FLORES-200, XQuAD/SQuAD, and XOR-TyDi. English samples and existing Indic translations are reused, while professional contract translators complete missing language/task fields. The release preserves task/language/split JSON files, source-dependent licenses, and a benchmark canary. Main evaluation is one-shot, with zero-, five-shot, prompt-language, and multilingual fine-tuning analyses. ChrF scores CrossSum and both FLORES directions; SQuAD Token-F1 scores all three QA tasks. Results are reported by high-, medium-, and low-resource language groups and analyze the gap from English.
